title: Terminology Support Package - Tests
introduction: Resources a terminology server loads to run some of the HL7 terminology ecosystem tests (hl7.fhir.uv.tx-ecosystem): content the tests need the server to hold, rather than pass in tx-resource. Test content only - not for production servers. These are R5+ resources

list.desc: First release: glp-base-da, a supplement the server holds, for the tests of useSupplement with no version
